title: LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. translated_title: 基于结构化配方优化的自动化后训练大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 自动化后训练旨在在有限的实验预算下，通过自动构建和优化一个涵盖数据源、数据处理、跨域组合和训练配置等耦合决策的配方，将预训练的大语言模型（LLM）转变为能够处理多种领域的模型。现有的自动化方法要么搜索预定义的配方空间，这种方式能够实现系统性优化，但配方空间是固定的，无法根据目标任务调整其可选选项；要么使用开放式的智能体，虽然能够发现针对特定任务的选择，但这些选择隐含在试验级别的编辑中，限制了它们在多次试验之间的系统性复用与重组。为填补这一空白，我们引入了任务自适应配方空间上的优化，这是一种新范式，它能够将配方空间本身适应于目标任务，同时显式地表示其中的选项，从而实现系统性复用、重组和联合优化。我们实例化了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新范式——任务自适应配方空间优化，使LLM智能体在自动化后训练中既能将配方空间本身适配目标任务，又能显式表示各选项，从而实现决策的系统性复用、重组与联合优化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm enabling LLM agents to adapt the recipe space itself to target tasks while explicitly representing choices, allowing systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization in automated post-training.
